case_title.correct_value: State of M.P. v. Ashok & Others Etc.
case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption, STATE OF M.P. v. ASHOK & OTHERS ETC.

number_of_accused.quote: respondent no.6 namely Surendra s/o Harilal Vedehi had died... proceedings stand abated
number_of_accused.reason: Six respondents, but Surendra's proceedings abated on death, leaving five whose liability is decided.

accused_gender.quote: Ashok s/o Banshilal Vedehi, Raju @ Rajendra s/o Banshilal Vedehi
accused_gender.reason: Accused are described as sons of named fathers, consistent with male gender.

accused_age.reason: No age of any accused is given in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described; 'Maharaj' appears only in place or person names.

accused_caste.reason: Caste or community is not named; surnames alone are not a stated caste.

accused_occupation.reason: Only the victim's occupation (petrol pump duty) is mentioned; no accused occupation is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth, poverty or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned for any accused.

victim_gender.quote: Tikaram son of Chote Lal Pandey... he was stopped
victim_gender.reason: Victim is a male, described as son and with male pronouns.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated anywhere in the judgment.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is described.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute with Dibbu and others (per victim's statement); no separate relationship with respondents described
accused_victim_relationship.quote: There is an old enmity and quarrel was going on between us and Dibbu etc.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Victim's statement describes prior enmity; the value accurately notes no separate respondent-specific relationship.

offence_category.reason: Charges were under s.302 IPC read with s.149, which is murder.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 r/w s.149; IPC s.147
statutory_provisions.quote: others namely the present respondents... found guilty under section 302 read with section 149 I.P.C.
statutory_provisions.reason: Respondents convicted under s.302 r/w s.149 and sentenced under s.147 IPC.

weapon.correct_value: Sword (thrown by Harilal) and burning tyre (thrown by Vidhna); petrol and matchstick used by Dibbu and Jittu
weapon.quote: Respondent Vidhna @ Ramdas threw a burning tyre upon him. While Tikaram was running helter-skelter, Harilal threw a sword at him.
weapon.reason: Weapons, throwers and the petrol and matchstick used by others are all accurately identified.

evidence_type.quote: Dying declarations namely statements Exts.P-20 and P-17, so also oral declarations... and the eye-witness account through PW13
evidence_type.reason: Dying declarations, eyewitness and post-mortem evidence are all relied on.

confession.reason: No confession by any accused is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Group waited in ambush, surrounded the victim to prevent escape, threw burning tyre and sword
aggravating_circumstances.quote: The sequence of narration certainly shows that they were waiting in ambush.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Ambush, encircling to prevent escape, and the tyre and sword attack are all in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Respondents convicted under s.302 r/w s.149 (life) and s.147 (6 months RI); Dibbu and Jittu under s.302 (life) and s.148 (1 year RI)
trial_court_outcome.quote: rigorous imprisonment of one year under section 148 I.P.C. ... rigorous imprisonment for 6 month under section 147
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sentences and sections match the trial court order described in the judgment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Respondents given benefit of doubt and acquitted; Dibbu and Jittu convictions affirmed; Harilal and Banshilal appeals abated on death
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court however gava benefit of doubt to the respondents... Harilal and Banshilal had died and... appeals were declared to have abated.
high_court_outcome.reason: Matches High Court treatment of respondents, affirmed co-accused convictions and abatement.

final_outcome.quote: we allow these appeals, set-aside the judgment and order of acquittal... and restore the judgment of conviction
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court restored the respondents' conviction.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: IPC s.302 read with s.149; IPC s.147
offence_finally_established.quote: restore the judgment of conviction and sentence as recorded by the trial Court against the respondents
offence_finally_established.reason: Restored conviction covers s.302 r/w s.149 and s.147 for respondents.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced to life imprisonment under section 302 read with section 149
imprisonment_type.reason: Restored trial court sentence for respondents was life imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Final sentence is life imprisonment, not a fixed term, so null is correct.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but the brother's arrival is described without asserting that relatives came; PW15's relationship is not stated.
neutral_facts.quote: relatives came to the scene before the victim was taken to hospital
neutral_facts.reason: Judgment says only PW4 (victim's son) and PW15 rushed to scene; PW15's relation to victim is not stated.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum for s.302.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Death from burns (about 90%) and incised wound on back of chest
physical_harm.quote: The deceased was burnt about 90%... Incised wound obliquely on back of chest.
physical_harm.reason: Death, burn extent and chest incised wound are accurately recorded.

number_of_offences.quote: others... were found guilty under section 302 read with section 149 I.P.C.
number_of_offences.reason: Two sections (s.302 r/w s.149 and s.147) apply to respondents and both are restored.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Waiting in ambush and preparedness found; no express premeditation finding
premeditation_planning.quote: Even if one of them was ready with a sword, that is clearly indicative of the level of preparedness
premeditation_planning.reason: Ambush and preparedness are found; no express premeditation finding is made.

motive.correct_value: alleged: revenge for old enmity and quarrel; Court did not separately decide motive
motive.quote: For taking revenge from the said enmity today they poured petrol on me
motive.reason: Revenge motive is alleged in the victim's statement and the Court did not decide it.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Dying declarations Ext. P-20 and P-17; PW13 eyewitness testimony; post-mortem incised injury
key_evidence_accepted.quote: Both these statements are consistent and name the present respondents
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on dying declarations, PW13's eyewitness account and the post-mortem injury.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW13 accepted as eyewitness; High Court did not disbelieve him; High Court finding against record
witness_credibility.quote: we find the presence of said PW13 completely established and accept him to be eye witness
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the Court's acceptance of PW13 and its view that the High Court was against record.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No accused post-offence conduct is described.

custody_duration.reason: No custody period for the respondents is stated.

bail_history.reason: No bail grant or refusal is mentioned.

trial_duration.correct_value: offence: 11.04.1989; trial judgment: not given; High Court: 11.01.2007; Supreme Court: 01.07.2015
trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 11.01.2007... Allowing the appeals... July01,2015
trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.correct_value: State: Vanshaja Shukla, Mishra Saurabh; Respondents: Akshat Shrivastava, Sarabjit Dutta
legal_representation.quote: Vanshaja Shukla, Mishra Saurabh for the Appellant. Akshat Shrivastava, Sarabjit Dutta for the Respondents.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names and sides match the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR registered (Ext. P-20); investigation completed; charge sheet against 10 accused; 20 prosecution and 3 defence witnesses
investigation_status.quote: After due investigation charge sheet was filed and 10 accused persons were sent for trial.
investigation_status.reason: Registration, charge sheet, and witness counts match the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment notes no procedural lapse.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: all 10 convicted; High Court: Dibbu and Jittu affirmed, respondents acquitted, Harilal and Banshilal abated; Supreme Court: appeals allowed, conviction restored
appeal_history.quote: The judgment of the High Court affirming their conviction and sentence has not been challenged
appeal_history.reason: Each level's outcome matches the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Role established by dying declarations and eyewitness; post-mortem supports eyewitness; High Court view unsustainable
prosecution_argument.quote: In her submission, the view taken by the High Court was completely unsustainable.
prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the State's submissions as recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: Principal role in dying declarations not attributed to respondents; benefit of doubt rightly granted
defence_argument.quote: It was submitted that the principal role as alleged in the dying declarations was not as regards the present respondents
defence_argument.reason: Matches the respondents' submission recorded in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Unlawful assembly membership inferred from presence, preparedness and participation; slow to interfere with acquittal but may where against record
legal_principle_applied.quote: Though we are conscious that while considering an appeal against acquittal we should be extremely slow in interfering
legal_principle_applied.reason: Both the membership inference and the appellate caution principle are stated in the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent or case citation is relied on in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: The Court restored the trial sentence without a separate sentencing rationale.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Active role (burning tyre, sword); preparedness with sword; encircling victim to prevent escape
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: Further, throwing of burning tyre and the sword would also indicate the active role played by them.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: These are the aggravating factors the Court expressly weighed.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Respondents to be taken into custody forthwith; proceedings abated against respondent no.6 Surendra
other_sentence_order.quote: The respondents shall be taken in custody forthwith to serve the sentence awarded to them.
other_sentence_order.reason: Custody direction and abatement against Surendra are both ordered.
